adminMessage.title: Admin Message
adminMessage.description: Internal error detail for admins. Do not show to the user.

answerCaptureTemplate.title: Answer Capture Template
answerCaptureTemplate.description: Structured answer input template. Usually blank after final save.

answersJson.title: Answers JSON
answersJson.description: Final answers JSON saved by SmartIntake.

brandingJson.title: Branding JSON
brandingJson.description: Branding configuration for the SmartIntake experience.

consentMessage.title: Consent Message
consentMessage.description: Consent message used when consent is required.

currentQuestion.title: Current Question Contract
currentQuestion.description: Structured question contract. Usually blank after final save.

errorCode.title: Error Code
errorCode.description: Machine-readable error code for debugging failed final saves.

errorType.title: Error Type
errorType.description: Category of error when success is false.

intakeSessionId.title: Intake Session Id
intakeSessionId.description: Session id for the completed SmartIntake intake.

isComplete.title: Is Complete
isComplete.description: True when the intake session is complete.

primaryRecordId.title: Primary Record Id
primaryRecordId.description: Salesforce record id created by the final SmartIntake save.

progressJson.title: Progress JSON
progressJson.description: Final progress state for the completed intake.

questionJson.title: Question JSON
questionJson.description: Question details. Usually blank after final save.

requiresConsent.title: Requires Consent
requiresConsent.description: True if consent was required before final save.

requiresFinalConfirmation.title: Requires Final Confirmation
requiresFinalConfirmation.description: True if final confirmation is still required before saving.

success.title: Success
success.description: True when the final intake record was saved successfully.

templateKey.title: Template Key
templateKey.description: Echo of the template key used for this intake session.

userMessage.title: User Message
userMessage.description: User-facing save result message. Show this after the final save completes.
